description: This file contains unit tests for the SetPlaybackRate task in the media player, specifically testing the behavior of setting playback rate in various pipeline states and sink configurations using Google Test framework.

classes.name: SetPlaybackRateTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing SetPlaybackRate task behavior in various scenarios.

methods.name: shouldNotChangePlaybackRateIfItsAlreadySet
methods.description: Tests that the playback rate is not changed if it is already set to the desired rate.

methods.name: shouldNotChangePlaybackRateIfPipelineIsNull
methods.description: Tests that the playback rate is not changed if the pipeline is null.

methods.name: shouldNotChangePlaybackRateIfPipelineStateIsBelowPlaying
methods.description: Tests that the playback rate is not changed if the pipeline state is below 'playing'.

methods.name: shouldSetPlaybackRateAudioSinkNull
methods.description: Tests setting playback rate when the audio sink is null, expecting a custom event to be sent.

methods.name: shouldFailToSetPlaybackRateAudioSinkNull
methods.description: Tests failure to set playback rate when the event cannot be sent.

methods.name: shouldSetPlaybackRateAudioSinkOtherThanAmlhala
methods.description: Tests setting playback rate for an audio sink other than 'amlhalasink', expecting a custom event.

methods.name: shouldFailToSetPlaybackRateAudioSinkOtherThanAmlhala
methods.description: Tests failure to set playback rate for an audio sink other than 'amlhalasink'.

methods.name: shouldSetPlaybackRateAmlhalaAudioSink
methods.description: Tests setting playback rate for 'amlhalasink' audio sink, expecting a segment event.

methods.name: shouldFailToSetPlaybackRateAmlhalaAudioSink
methods.description: Tests failure to set playback rate for 'amlhalasink' audio sink when sending segment event fails.
